local_date_label: 2026-10-09 (label requested by parent based on user local date; environment timezone UTC)
selection: Unchanged 16 frozen A6/B6/P4 transfer tasks in original selection-slot order; no replacement, enlargement or tuning on this panel.

baseline.algorithm: Iterated local search (ILS), not historical HGS
baseline.settings: Default SolveParams(); seed explicitly fixed per call; collect_stats=True; display=False; no parameter tuning, no warm start, no reference target, no fleet minimisation.

task_semantics.customers: Every non-depot input node mandatory, served once; no optional clients, shipments, time windows, pickups or reloads.
task_semantics.fleet: One vehicle type: num_available=K_ref, capacity=Q, start/end same depot0; at most K_ref nonempty routes.
task_semantics.metric: Closed-depot sum of all edge integers floor(hypot(dx,dy)+0.5), exact same EUC_2D rounding as historical study. No scaling.
task_semantics.objective: Fixed vehicle cost=0; unit distance cost=1; unit duration and overtime cost=0; all duration entries=0; prize=0; no route-count lexicographic objective.
task_semantics.route_output: Save native activity types/indices and mapped routes. Each CLIENT Activity.idx is resolved by data.client(idx).location and an explicit location-to-input-node map; use is_client/is_depot, never numeric activity tags. Routes include depot endpoints. No extra forced nonempty routes.

schedule.order: original selection_slot 1..16, each seeds 0,1,2; sequential fresh worker process, never concurrent
schedule.initial_solution: None; upstream internal random initial solution and local search per independent call; no user-produced or reference warm start.

budget.search_stop: MaxRuntime(1.0), timing starts on first stop callback in main ILS loop; initialization/model construction/imports excluded by upstream semantics. Not a one-second hard end-to-end limit.
budget.audit_only: Record model/solve/process wall and CPU/runtime/iterations; do not compare these with historical TSR or claim equal compute.
budget.reproducibility: Wall-time stop means same seed does not guarantee bitwise repeatability; freeze software/wheel hashes and retain the one realized run.
budget.combined_AS_bound_scope: Supervisor soft512/hard1024MiB plus at most one worker soft/hard1024MiB: current soft-limit sum1536MiB; theoretical hard-limit sum2048MiB. Does not include outer launcher/archive or unrelated services. Address-space bounds are not actual RSS usage; actual maxrss is separately audited.
budget.configured_CPU_limit_scope: 260 seconds is the sum of configured RLIMIT_CPU values for supervisor plus 48 optimizer workers only. Preparation, installation, outer launcher packaging, archive uploads/downloads and postprocessing are outside this search/control resource bound.
budget.CPU_enforcement_granularity: Configured RLIMIT_CPU hard values do not assert exact elapsed CPU cutoffs. Kernel accounting/scheduling granularity can cause observed CPU to exceed configured limits (demonstrated by synthetic failure fixture). Report actual CPU separately; 260s is not a mathematically strict realized end-to-end bound.

primary.per_instance: Mean of exactly 3 independently validated seed costs; subtract from historical TSR via 100*(TSRcost-meanPyVRPcost)/referenceCost; positive means historical TSR has higher cost.
primary.aggregate: Arithmetic mean of 16 per-instance differences, equal instance weighting. Also mean reference gap for each method.
primary.missing: If any seed missing/failed/invalid, that task 3-seed primary is unavailable. If any task unavailable, all16 primary aggregate is null. Explicit available-complete-task descriptive denominator, plus raw seed denominator.

secondary: All 48 seed rows, each task min/max/range/sample SD and mean; best-of-3 only supplementary and labeled three-run selection; integer TSR vs sum(seedCosts)/3 win/tie/loss with exact integer cross multiplication; optional percentage excess over baseline mean clearly separate denominator. No favorable seed selection in primary.
failure_policy: Within each separately frozen revision: Exclusive STARTED guard; one attempt per scheduled call; retain stdout/stderr/timeouts/malformed/infeasible rows, no delete/retry/replacement; continue independent later slots unless supervisor fatal, mark never-started slots unavailable; archive incomplete raw immediately before diagnosis. Child always killed/reaped in finally; unique external launcher kills the entire supervisor process group after termination/timeout before raw packaging. Worker env is an explicit non-secret whitelist, omits PYTHONPATH/HOME overrides and optimization, and requires assertions enabled.
reference_isolation: Solver worker receives only coordinates, demands, capacity, K and seed/runtime via stdin. Import dependencies first then audit-hook deny open/socket/subprocess operations during model/solve; no file paths, IDs, reference routes/costs or historical routes/costs in payload. Historical/reference files available only to read-only endpoint evaluation after RAW_UNREVIEWED remote byte readback. Researchers know historic outcomes: not blind.
independent_validation: Standalone separately authored stdlib Decimal80 ROUND_HALF_UP parser/validator, original .vrp versus copied normalized input all-pair integer matrix check, required coverage once, legal indices/depot endpoints, capacity, <=K nonempty, route cost versus solver cost; verify historical TSR routes and reference feasibility/cost without optimization.
gates: installation authorization and exact wheel/hash dependency capture

limitations: Mature public package chosen by capability/availability before formal outputs; no assumption it must beat TSR.
Quality comparison only, different search algorithms/initialization/stopping rules/compute budgets.
Public references are feasible comparison values, not optimality proofs established here.
No significance, universal superiority or SOTA claims; selected 16 task panel only.
No new data generalization test: these tasks were already analyzed in historic TSR study.
Timed search realizations hardware/load dependent; public source benchmarks do not establish this panel outcome.

The Python audit hook records/blocks Python-level IO events after imports. It is not an OS/native-code syscall sandbox or proof of zero native IO; algorithm payload and reviewed adapter isolate reference/history data.
